name: kb_371_Normalized

https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: FlowSchemaCondition describes conditions for a FlowSchema.

lastTransitionTime.description: `lastTransitionTime` is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: `message` is a human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: `reason` is a unique, one-word, CamelCase reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: `status` is the status of the condition. Can be True, False, Unknown. Required.

type.description: `type` is the type of the condition. Required.

https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: Time is a wrapper around time.Time which supports correct marshaling to YAML and JSON.  Wrappers are provided for many of the factory methods that the time package offers.

schema.description: FlowSchemaStatus represents the current state of a FlowSchema.

conditions.description: `conditions` is a list of the current states of FlowSchema.

description:
The FlowSchema is currently reporting two distinct conditions. The **Ready** condition transitioned to a **True** status on **2024-05-12T08:15:30Z**; the change was recorded under the reason **InitialSetupComplete**, with the accompanying note that “The FlowSchema is ready for processing.”

The second condition, **Pending**, is marked as **False** as of **2024-06-10T14:42:07Z**. This status change is attributed to the reason **QuotaExceeded**, and the message explains that “The FlowSchema cannot accept new requests due to quota limits.”

conditions.message: The FlowSchema is ready for processing.
The FlowSchema cannot accept new requests due to quota limits.
